name: Joaquin Castro
stance: Supports international AI guardrails and U.S.-China diplomacy on catastrophic AI risk; a repeat signer of the House AI-safety letters.

statements.text: Signed the Ansari-led letter demanding the administration act on AI global security and guardrails against uncontrollable frontier AI.
Co-signed a 26-Democrat letter urging AI-safety diplomacy with China against catastrophic risks like AI-enabled pathogens and cyberattacks.

review.note: added October 2026; letter signatures verified via the leads' primary releases
